name: CombatStyle
description: Set how follower(s) fight: melee, ranged (bow) or magic.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers.

style.description: The fighting style, exactly one of: melee, ranged, magic.

prompt: If the player asks you to fight in melee, use your bow or use magic, begin your response with '{key}:'
